datasets.title: Apple Inc. Daily OHLCV (Feb 2015 - Feb 2017)
datasets.origin: Daily open/high/low/close/volume bars for AAPL with split- and dividend-adjusted closes, as distributed in Plotly's finance chart examples.
datasets.notes: Two years of daily bars is a short sample for a trading study, and that limitation drives the conclusion rather than being hidden from it. Always use AAPL.Adjusted rather than AAPL.Close: the unadjusted series contains a price discontinuity at every dividend that a naive model reads as a real move.
